description: Preview what a run would cost — does not execute, create a job, or charge the wallet. Use before spending when the user asks about price; use hydracept_run or hydracept_submit_job only to execute. Not the same as request_capability_quote (POST /mcp/full) on the full profile (human-paid capability commission). Requires bearer API key. No charge for the quote itself. Returns: Quote envelope with customerTotal and currency (no wallet charge). Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, FundingRequired when quote cannot be priced.
